sentences.text: It is a private complaint filed by the 2nd respondent alleging offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 IPC.
Annexure - A1 is the private complaint.
2. According to the petitioners, even if the entire allegations in Annexure - A1 are accepted, no offences under Sections 406 and 420 IPC are made out.

3. After going through Annexure - A1 complaint, I am of the considered opinion that the contentions raised by the petitioners can be raised before the trial 2024:KER:75393 court by filing a discharge petition.
Considering the facts and circumstance of the case, the petitioners can be allowed to appear before the trial court through a lawyer.

Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is disposed of in the following manner:
1. The petitioners are free to file an application for exemption from personal appearance before the jurisdictional court, within 30 days from the date of receipt of a stamped certified copy of this order.
2.
If such an application is received, the learned Magistrate will allow the same on condition that the petitioners will appear on posting days on which their presence is inevitable.
The petitioners are also free to file a discharge petition before the trial court at the appropriate stage.
4. All the contentions raised by the petitioners in this criminal miscellaneous case are left open.
The Registry will forward a copy of this order to the jurisdictional court forthwith.
